tables.description: Primary fact table for weekly player stats and ownership. Use for questions about weekly scores, benching vs starting, and specific game stats.

columns.season_id: The unique primary key for a fantasy season, representing the calendar year.
columns.game_week: The week of the NFL season for this stat line.
columns.player_name: The full name of the NFL player.
columns.owner_name: The display name of the fantasy owner.
columns.fantasy_team_name: The name of the fantasy team for that season.
columns.is_starting: Indicates if the player was in a starting lineup position.
columns.total_fantasy_points: The player's total fantasy points for this specific week.
columns.pass_yds: Total passing yards for the week.
columns.pass_tds: Total passing touchdowns for the week.
columns.rush_yds: Total rushing yards for the week.
columns.rush_tds: Total rushing touchdowns for the week.
columns.rec_yds: Total receiving yards for the week.
columns.rec_tds: Total receiving touchdowns for the week.

tables.description: Seasonal totals and rankings for all players across all positions.

columns.player_name: The full name of the player.
columns.games_played: Number of games played in that season.
columns.total_fantasy_points: The player's total fantasy points for the entire season.
columns.season_rank: The player's final rank among all players at their position for the season.

tables.description: Symmetric head-to-head game log with two rows per matchup (one for each manager).

columns.season_id: The season year the matchup took place.
columns.nfl_week: The week of the NFL season.
columns.fantasy_week: The name or number of the fantasy week.
columns.manager_name: The name of the primary manager for this row.
columns.manager_team: The name of the manager's fantasy team.
columns.manager_score: The final fantasy point total for the manager.
columns.opponent_name: The name of the opponent manager.
columns.opponent_team: The name of the opponent's team.
columns.opponent_score: The final fantasy point total for the opponent.
columns.margin_of_victory: The absolute point difference between the two scores.
columns.outcome: The result for the manager: 'Win', 'Loss', or 'Tie'.

tables.description: Analyzes draft ROI by comparing picks to season ROI metrics.

columns.season_id: The season year of the draft.
columns.player_name: The name of the drafted player.
columns.owner_name: The name of the owner who made the pick.
columns.pick_overall: The overall pick number in the entire draft.
columns.draft_value_vs_adp: Indicates how much of a 'reach' or 'steal' the pick was compared to market ADP.
columns.total_season_points: Total fantasy points the player scored during that entire season.
columns.points_scored_over_expected: Difference between actual points and expected points from that draft slot.
columns.finish_rank: The player's final rank among all players at their position.
columns.draft_rank: The rank of the player at their position when drafted.
columns.rank_diff: Difference between draft rank and final finish rank.

tables.description: Final team records and standings for every season.

columns.owner_name: The name of the team's owner.
columns.regular_season_wins: Number of wins during the regular season only.
columns.final_standing: The team's final rank including playoffs.
columns.is_champion: Indicates if the team won the championship.

tables.description: Aggregated career statistics for every owner.

columns.owner_name: The display name of the fantasy owner.
columns.career_wins: Total wins including regular season and playoffs.
columns.championships_won: The total number of championships won.
columns.career_playoff_rate: Percentage of seasons where manager qualified for playoffs.

tables.description: Career totals and biographical summary for every player.

columns.player_name: The full name of the player.
columns.primary_position: The main position the player has played.
columns.career_games_played: Total number of games played over their career.
columns.total_seasons_active: Number of seasons the player has been active.

tables.description: Master player identity table to resolve names to unique IDs.

columns.player_id: The unique primary key for an individual player.
columns.player_name: The full name of the player.
